categories.main_business_segments: Hezong Science & Technology operates primarily in two segments: the power sector and the lithium battery cathode materials sector. The power segment focuses on research, manufacturing, and sales of distribution, transformation, and control equipment, as well as related engineering, design, and technical services. The lithium battery segment, led by its controlling subsidiary Hunan Yacheng, specializes in the R&D, production, and sales of lithium battery cathode precursors such as lithium iron phosphate and cobalt oxides.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including ammonium-based processes for lithium iron phosphate production, high-pressure leaching wet smelting for cobalt and nickel sulfate production, and integrates digital and smart grid technologies in power equipment. It emphasizes proprietary R&D in product design, simulation, and manufacturing, including high-voltage switchgear, integrated energy storage systems, and nanomaterial additives for battery cathodes. The lithium materials segment collaborates with universities and research institutes to innovate production processes and product performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies such as State Grid and Southern Grid, industrial and commercial enterprises, new energy vehicle manufacturers, and energy storage system integrators. The lithium battery materials serve major battery producers and electronics manufacturers, including recognized brands like BYD, Samsung SDI, and ATL. The company also targets overseas markets and EPC clients in power and renewable energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Hezong operates mainly within mainland China, covering 29 provinces and autonomous regions with strong market presence in Guangdong, Jiangsu, Shandong, Henan, and Hebei. It also has overseas operations including subsidiaries in Indonesia and Hong Kong, and exports lithium battery materials internationally. The company’s EPC and power equipment services extend to domestic and select international projects.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. In the power sector, it manufactures and supplies distribution and control equipment and provides engineering and EPC services. In the lithium battery sector, it produces cathode precursor materials, serving as a key upstream supplier to battery manufacturers. It also engages in raw material processing for cobalt and nickel products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing R&D capabilities to develop advanced power distribution equipment and high-performance lithium battery materials. The company focuses on smart grid technologies, energy storage integration, and nanomaterial additives for cathodes. It pursues cost optimization, product innovation, and expanding certification and market access for lithium materials. Collaboration with academic institutions and continuous technology upgrades underpin its innovation strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of power equipment and lithium battery materials, EPC engineering contracts, and technical services. The company uses a direct sales model, often winning contracts via bidding processes. It also derives income from the sale of industrial metals like cobalt and nickel. Revenue recognition aligns with product delivery, project completion, or contract milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hezong is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in power distribution equipment and lithium battery cathode materials, with top rankings in ring main units and transformers. It competes with other Chinese power equipment manufacturers and lithium material suppliers, facing intensified competition due to industry capacity expansions and price pressures. The company leverages its integrated service capabilities and R&D strengths to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.65 billion, a 10.33% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -631 million. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 5.42 billion, down 44% year-over-year, reflecting asset impairments and restructuring. Despite losses, cash flow from operations improved significantly. The company faces challenges from market price declines in lithium materials and operational difficulties in some subsidiaries but continues to invest in R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hezong emphasizes its integrated one-stop solutions in power distribution, combining design, manufacturing, EPC services, and after-sales support. Its lithium battery materials boast high purity, stable quality, and advanced production processes, meeting stringent customer certifications. The company highlights its technological innovation, product reliability, and comprehensive service ecosystem as key differentiators, aiming to deliver superior performance and cost-effective solutions to customers in the evolving energy and new materials markets.
